_comment: Dependency licence policy for DentalVoice Studio (project licence: MIT). Edited by hand; see docs/license-audit.md. Licences are SPDX identifiers.

allowed.BSD-2-Clause: Keep copyright notice, conditions and disclaimer.
allowed.BSD-3-Clause: Keep copyright notice, conditions and disclaimer; no endorsement using contributors' names.
allowed.Apache-2.0: Keep licence and any NOTICE file content; state changes to modified files.
allowed.PSF-2.0: Keep the PSF licence and copyright notice.
allowed.Python-2.0: Keep the Python licence and copyright notice.
allowed.BlueOak-1.0.0: Keep the licence text or a link to it.

conditional.MPL-2.0: Weak (file-level) copyleft. Compatible when used as an unmodified dependency; any modified MPL-covered file must stay under MPL-2.0 with its source available.
conditional.LGPL-3.0-or-later: Weak copyleft. Compatible when dynamically linked and unmodified. Anyone who distributes a binary or image containing it must provide the licence text and the library's source (or an offer), and allow it to be replaced.
conditional.CC-BY-4.0: Attribution licence for data. Credit the source when redistributing the data.

reviewed.rationale: Runtime since Milestone 4 (Mozilla CA bundle used by requests/httpx inside the Gemini client) and development. Shipped unmodified; MPL-2.0 is file-level copyleft, so the obligations are to keep the files unmodified with their licence notice (listed in THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md) and point to the public source. Reviewed 2026-10-31.
Development-only (pulled in by mypy); unmodified; not in the runtime image.
Build/test tooling (Tailwind CSS compiler, accessibility checks); unmodified; not in the runtime image.

Optional dependency of next via sharp (image optimisation; unused by the app). Unmodified, dynamically loaded. Ships in the frontend Docker image: anyone distributing that image must meet the LGPL obligations. The repository distributes source only. Owner may later drop sharp (see docs/license-audit.md).
Browser-support data used by the build toolchain; attribution to caniuse.com/Can I Use is recorded in THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md.
